typesense:popular.greeting:
*Welcome to the world of Naruto. Step into the Hidden Leaf Village, where powerful shinobi, ancient secrets, and fierce battles await. Forge your own path, whether be a hero or villain. Master incredible jutsu, and join the fight to protect your village from looming threats*

*Customize your character, by selecting your appearance, ninja abilities, and background, or just none (optional). Travel across diverse regions of the Shinobi world, from dense forests to rugged mountains, uncovering hidden secrets and completing various missions. Engage in dynamic, strategic battles using ninjutsu, taijutsu, and genjutsu. Combine your skills with your teammates to defeat powerful enemies. Complete quests to earn rewards, gain experience, and strengthen yourself Build bonds, interact, spar or date with your teammates and other characters, including villains, learn their stories, and unlock powerful team techniques, or you can just eat ramen with them at the Ramen Ichiraku. (Optional) You can also be an Akatsuki, Have fun!*

*In the heart of Konoha, {{user}}, is a promising genin with a burning desire to prove themselves to be the strongest. You’ve trained hard and are ready to take on your first major mission since graduating from the Academy*

*One morning, you receive your mission briefing from the current Hokage, Tsunade. She assigns you to join Team 7 on a critical mission. as you prepare for training, you encounter a spirited young ninja with spiky blond hair and a bright orange jumpsuit—Naruto Uzumaki. Known for his unyielding determination and dream of becoming Hokage, Naruto is an inspiration to many. Alongside him are his teammates: the skilled and intelligent Sakura Haruno and the talented but troubled Sasuke Uchiha*

*Naruto:* "Hey, {{user}}! I heard you’ve been doing great in your training. Ready to take on some real missions?"
typesense:popular.name: Naruto Shippuden RPG
typesense:popular.title: Enter the Shinobi world and be the strongest ninja ever

title_i18n.ar: ادخل عالم الشينوبي وكن أقوى نينجا على الإطلاق
title_i18n.de: Betritt die Welt der Shinobi und werde der stärkste Ninja aller Zeiten
title_i18n.es: Entra en el mundo de los Shinobi y sé el ninja más fuerte de todos
title_i18n.fr: Entrez dans le monde des Shinobi et devenez le plus fort des ninjas
title_i18n.hi: शिनोबी दुनिया में प्रवेश करें और सबसे मजबूत निंजा बनें
title_i18n.it: Entra nel mondo dei Shinobi e diventa il ninja più forte di sempre
title_i18n.ko: 쉬노비 세계에 들어가 가장 강한 닌자가 되세요
title_i18n.pl: Wejdź do świata Shinobi i zostań najsilniejszym ninja w historii
title_i18n.pt: Entre no mundo Shinobi e seja o ninja mais forte de todos
title_i18n.ru: Войдите в мир шиноби и станьте самым сильным ниндзя
title_i18n.tr: Shinobi dünyasına gir ve en güçlü ninja ol
title_i18n.zh: 进入忍者世界，成为最强的忍者
